facts.fact: UNESCO's contribution to the 46th Universal Periodic Review states that no access to information laws have been adopted in the Comoros and names no draft; the document gives no event date, so this is dated to its publication month, January 2026.

systems.system: Code de l'information et de la communication (loi N°21-011/AU, 2021)
systems.country_label: Code de l'information et de la communication en Union des Comores

note: Reports promulgation of a press and communication code (code de l'information); it states a freedom of communication and a media regulator, not a right to ask public bodies for information.

claims.gtmi-3875b89e1a: nothing: the document is a press and communication code, with no right to ask public bodies for information

facts.fact: UNESCWA's December 2025 Comoros anti-corruption profile says transparency is not yet clearly defined in the legislative framework and recommends developing a law guaranteeing the right to access information, so none is in place.
